units.source_text: 他望见海边的波浪来来去去，便吟唱古歌：

en.t: He saw the waves by the shore coming and going, and so he chanted an old poem:

units.source_text: “行行渐觉离愁重，却羡波臣去复回。”

en.t: The farther I go, the heavier the sorrow of parting grows; I can only envy the servants of the waves, who go away and return again.

units.source_text: 这古歌虽是妇孺皆知，但在目前情景之下，

en.t: Although this old poem was known to women and children alike, in the present circumstances,

units.source_text: 吟之异常动人，诸随从听了无不悲伤。

en.t: his reciting it was extraordinarily moving, and all the attendants who heard it were filled with sorrow.

units.source_text: 回顾来处，但见云雾弥漫，

en.t: Looking back toward the place from which he had come, he saw only clouds and mist spreading everywhere,

units.source_text: 群山隐约难辨，诚如白居易所云，

en.t: with the mountains dim and hard to make out, just as Bai Juyi had written,

units.source_text: 自身正是“三千里外远行人”了。

en.t: he himself had truly become a traveler far away, three thousand li from home.

units.source_text: 眼泪就像桨水一般滴下来，难于抑止。

en.t: His tears dripped down like water from an oar, impossible to hold back.
